description: Primary: FDA-deduplicated sole-suspect (PS, zero SS) monotherapy excluding co-reported antineoplastics
Sensitivity 1: FDA-deduplicated Primary Suspect (PS, SS allowed) excluding co-reported antineoplastics
Sensitivity 2: Primary restricted to healthcare professional reporters (MD/PH/OT)
Sensitivity 3: Primary restricted to serious reports (any FDA OUTC code)
Sensitivity 4: Primary excluding head/neck/oral-cancer and radiotherapy indications
Sensitivity 5: Primary plus secondary exact demographic/event/drug/PT deduplication
Sensitivity 6 (negative-confounding check): All deduplicated PS reports without co-antineoplastic exclusion
